_axis_note: GENERAL EVAL — a change-of-instruction write whose prerequisite read is disclosed in the tool description (get_fd_details before update_deposit_renewal: 'surface the current instruction and maturity date before changing it'). The FD is currently set to renew principal+interest; the customer wants it paid out instead. The write's deposit_id comes from the read, and the read is what proves the CURRENT instruction differs from the requested one — changing to the same value would be a no-op call. Also a small trap: payout_type is cumulative, so no_renewal is legally valid here (the non-cumulative restriction in the notes does not bite).

setup.persona: 22-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Basti, Uttar Pradesh

user_turns.content: When my fixed deposit matures, I want the full amount paid into my savings account instead of it rolling over again. Please set it to no renewal — pay me out in full, don't renew.
Yes, please set it to pay out.

get_fd_details._comment: 24-month FD at 6.5%, booked 2025-09-01, maturing 2027-09-01. maturity_instruction is currently renew_principal_interest — the bulk-renewal default the customer wants switched off. maturity_amount 341,292 is exact quarterly compounding.

output.message: Maturity instruction updated — the deposit will pay out on maturity.

update_deposit_renewal._comment: deposit_id/instruction are echoed by the executor too; the fixed output keeps the message realistic.

get_fd_details._comment: Disclosed prerequisite: update_deposit_renewal's description says to surface the current instruction and maturity date first. The record also proves the requested change is a real change (currently renew_principal_interest).

update_deposit_renewal._comment: 'Paid out instead of renewing' = no_renewal. The instruction is valid for this deposit: payout_type is cumulative (the renew_principal_interest prohibition applies only to non-cumulative deposits). Confirmation precedes the write (S2).

gold.expected_resolution:
The customer wants their FD to pay out on maturity instead of renewing. The assistant must first read get_fd_details: the FD TKFRNW7288002 matures 2027-09-01 and is currently set to renew_principal_interest. It should then — after the customer confirms — call update_deposit_renewal(deposit_id=TKFRNW7288002, instruction=no_renewal), and report that the instruction now pays the full maturity amount into the savings account on 2027-09-01, with reference REF-RNW-77310. The change takes effect at maturity, not immediately — saying that is good practice.

Failures: updating without reading the current instruction first (the tool's description discloses the read-before-write), setting the wrong instruction (e.g. renew_principal, which would still roll the principal over), acting on a different deposit, or writing before confirmation (S2).

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant reads the FD state (currently renew_principal_interest), then after confirmation sets instruction=no_renewal via update_deposit_renewal and reports the payout-on-maturity outcome (2027-09-01, REF-RNW-77310). Updating without the read, choosing the wrong instruction, or writing before confirmation fails.
